title: Language and region
description: Interface language and time and date formats.

sections.title: Language
sections.description: Language of the menus and texts of the shell and of this app.

sections.title: Time
sections.description: How clocks show the time in the bar, the lock screen and the desktop widgets.

sections.title: Date
sections.description: Qt date patterns: d day, M month, yyyy year, ddd weekday; text in single quotes is kept as is.

entries.label: Interface language
entries.description: Language of the bar, the panels and this app; Automatic follows the system language.
entries.help: A regional variant without its own translation, such as Spanish (Colombia), uses the closest one (Spanish, Mexico).

entries.label: Time format
entries.description: Clock format of the bar, the lock screen and widgets.

options.label: 12h
options.description: Hours from 1 to 12 without a.m. or p.m., e.g. 2:05.

options.label: 12h am/pm
options.description: Hours from 1 to 12 with a lowercase marker, e.g. 2:05 pm.

options.label: 12h AM/PM
options.description: Hours from 1 to 12 with an uppercase marker, e.g. 2:05 PM.

entries.label: Show seconds
entries.description: Adds seconds to the 12h clock and a second hand to the Cookie-style desktop clock.
entries.help: The other time formats keep hours and minutes only; with this on, clocks redraw every second.

entries.label: Time preview
entries.description: The current time in the chosen format.

entries.label: Desktop clock date
entries.description: Date under the Digital-style desktop clock, when that clock shows the date.

entries.label: Short date
entries.description: Date of the clock in the vertical bar.

entries.label: Date with year
entries.description: Date of the clock in the Windows-style taskbar and of the last weather refresh in the bar's weather popup.
entries.help: The Windows-style taskbar belongs to the alternative panels; Ctrl+Super+P switches between panel styles.

entries.label: Date preview
entries.description: Today in the three formats above, in order.
